why: No major reviewer or authority tests NAS units for this question. Fstoppers is the only famous name and gives editorial guidance without test data; NAS Compares' page is an old generic guide. The rest are affiliate roundups on recycled domains (virtual-pc, webdigi, kayakcambria, droid4x) with unverifiable "60 days testing" claims, a SaaS vendor blog, and niche sizing guides that name no model or recommend a $5.8k 64TB build. Nobody sizes a system for 10 TB of RAW or prices the box plus drives. A focused page with a direct pick, drive configuration, current prices and measured Lightroom performance would stand out.
